findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: This clause transfers intellectual property ownership upon delivery, which occurs before final payment is received. If the client delays or withholds final payment, they already own the work.
findings.suggested_change: Amend the clause to state that intellectual property rights transfer only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverable or project.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: This allows the client to terminate instantly without any obligation to pay for work already completed, leaving the contractor uncompensated for time and effort invested.
findings.suggested_change: Require advance written notice for termination and ensure the client is obligated to pay for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am excited to begin. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause about intellectual property, the agreement currently transfers ownership upon delivery before final payment is received, and I propose we amend the clause to state that intellectual property rights transfer only upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the termination clause, the agreement currently permits termination at any time without notice or further payment, and I propose we require advance written notice and ensure payment is provided for all services performed. Thank you for your time and understanding.
